Keyboard shortcuts

drag, scroll or ←↑→↓
Pan; hold Shift for bigger steps
Ctrl scroll, pinch or +−
Zoom
0
Fit to screen
click or Enter
Focus an element and its connections
Tab or ShiftTab
Move between nodes
Shift click or ShiftEnter
Trace the path from the focused node
Esc
Clear the path, focus or search
/
Search; Enter steps through matches
Ctrl click or CtrlEnter
Open an element’s link
C
Copy a link to the focused element or path
theme button
Switch between light and dark
?
Show or hide this help

The page’s address links to what is focused or traced.
